data.location: 3685 W Flamingo Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89103
data.short_description: Bojangles is planning to open its sixth Las Vegas Valley location at 3685 W Flamingo Rd, across from the Rio Hotel & Casino. The site previously housed an Outback Steakhouse, which is now permanently closed. The opening was confirmed by a company executive.

Pizaro's Pizza plans a new take-out-only location in the North Braes Shopping Center in Meyerland. Construction is slated to start in November and wrap up by end of March 2027. This location will not serve Neapolitan pizza but will offer New York and Detroit styles.

The Flower Cupcake Co. is opening a bakery and cafe at 5412 W Devon Avenue, serving cold brew coffee, iced matcha, and baked goods. Owner Cassandra Rosario is targeting a November opening. The building is next to King Pho Vietnamese restaurant, near Domino's Pizza and A Vintage Bloom florist.

data.location: 9634 Fair Oaks Blvd, Fair Oaks, CA 95628
data.short_description: Smokey Oaks Tavern is closing after nearly a decade, with owner Steve Hubble framing it as a rebrand rather than a full shutdown. A new concept called Live Fire & Smoke is set to take its place at the same address. No opening date has been announced for the new restaurant.

data.location: 9634 Fair Oaks Blvd, Fair Oaks, CA 95628
data.status: No opening date has been announced yet
data.short_description: Live Fire & Smoke is set to replace Smokey Oaks Tavern at the same address in Fair Oaks. Details on the concept remain limited, though the name suggests continued focus on live fire cooking and smoked dishes. No opening date has been announced yet.

Freeport Bakery is being sold by owners Marlene and Walter Goetzeler, who are retiring on September 7, to Lisa Calk of Ettore's Bakery & Café. Calk plans to keep Freeport exactly as it is. This is a change of ownership rather than a closing or new opening.

Chef-owners David Rouse and Billy Jones are moving their Metairie bistro Dr. Jones to a new Uptown location, possibly under a different name. The new spot will carry on the practice of serving elevated bistro fare. The current location seats about 24 guests and the owners have outgrown it.

data.store_name: The Pizza Bar (formerly Tru Pizza Co.)
data.short_description: Tru Pizza Co. in Wyandotte is converting into a new concept called The Pizza Bar, reopening this fall. The original concept debuted in January of this year and still operates in Troy and Plymouth. The new spot will feature pizza, cocktails, cold beer, live music and trivia.

data.store_name: Stellen San Diego Gaslamp (formerly Hotel Z)
data.short_description: Hotel Z is undergoing renovation and rebranding as Stellen San Diego Gaslamp under new owner Stoa Lodging, which purchased the property for $25.2 million. The renovated hotel will have 100 guestrooms, up from 96, and will introduce the property's first food and beverage outlet, a cafe. The property will remain open during construction.

The Acadiana-based Los Hermanos food truck, known for Mexican street food including smash tacos and birria burritos, is establishing a brick-and-mortar location in Kinder. A preview video shows an indoor dining room and covered outdoor patio. The truck has also previewed cocktails, suggesting a full bar.

KOI will bring New Orleans' first conveyor belt sushi concept to the Central Business District, next to the recently opened Juicy Seafood, which shares the same operating partner Leo Wu. It will feature a modern conveyor belt sushi system with prices starting at $3.50, plus hibachi offerings and a full bar.

Olive Garden remains tied to the planned Adams Village commercial development in Sanford, though it has not publicly confirmed the location. The 32-acre project is planned to include about 202,700 square feet of anchor retail space. A local report states Olive Garden is currently expected to open in 2027, though the timeline remains subject to change.

Zen Cafe, opened by Andrew Underwood and Annabel Figueroa, will occupy the former Saxby's space in Bethlehem. The cafe features a Japandi-style interior and will serve coffee from Devoción and matcha from ARTEAO, along with croissant sandwiches and scones.

Qazzaz Coffee is opening its second location in Farmington's developing downtown, following its Allen Park debut in 2024. Owner Mohammad Qazzaz does not yet have a confirmed opening date but is aiming for early October. The Farmington menu will be very similar to the current location's.

ReAnimator Coffee is set to open a new Manayunk location on the first floor commercial space at 4226 Main St., according to business filings. The shop currently operates five other Philadelphia-area locations plus a recently opened Mt. Airy spot. An official opening date has not yet been announced, but signage reads "Coming soon."

Marmalade Cafe closed its Calabasas location after 28 years of service. The brand will continue operating its Westlake Village, Malibu, Sherman Oaks, and El Segundo locations. The Calabasas spot was known for its comfort food and weekend brunches.

data.short_description: Punjabi Haveli, an Ontario-based Indian restaurant, is opening its fourth location in Scarborough. The team announced they are in the final stages of construction.
The Union Sky, a rooftop restaurant and cocktail lounge, is planning a fall opening atop Novi Lofts in downtown Concord. The venue will seat roughly 75 guests with an indoor space and rooftop patio.

King Corona 1902, a new cigar bar and members-only lounge from King Corona Cigar Lounge, is tentatively planning a November 1 opening in Ybor City. It will feature a public downstairs bar and an exclusive upstairs lounge.

Caragiulo's Italian American closed its historic Palm Avenue location due to redevelopment and is preparing to reopen at a new address on Ringling Boulevard. A representative confirmed the restaurant is about 30 days from reopening.

data.short_description: The Predator Group, a billiards supply company, is working to open a new restaurant and entertainment venue in Jacksonville. The project is still under city consideration and no menu or date has been announced.

Texas Roadhouse will be part of Venice Crossing, a mixed-use development in Nokomis also featuring Walmart, Home Depot, and other chain restaurants. It will be Sarasota County's newest Texas Roadhouse location, expected to open by spring 2027.

Caribou Coffee appears to be bringing a location to Hickory Flat this year, listed as a tenant for the new Hickory Flat Marketplace shopping center. The closest existing locations to Canton are in Woodstock and Milton. Caribou Coffee did not respond to requests for comment.

data.short_description: Open Air Dance Collective is eyeing a new location for its dance studio on Hancock Drive, per public filings. OADC is known for its non-competitive, high-level training program founded by Kerin Martinez.
Bi-Rite is preparing to open a new market on California Street per an ABC license filing, expanding into the Richmond District. An opening date has not yet been announced.
EōS Fitness is preparing to open a new 24/7 gym in Temecula near Winchester and Margarita roads. Planned amenities include group fitness classes, strength training areas, and a recovery room.
